description: This file defines the SwiftUI view 'SettingsRootView' for the application's settings interface, including various tabs like General, Channels, Skills, Sessions, Cron, Config, Instances, Voice Wake, Permissions, Debug, and About. It manages the UI layout, tab selection, permission monitoring, and some state handling related to settings configuration.

classes.name: SettingsTab
classes.description: An enum representing the different settings sections represented as tabs in the UI, with associated properties for title and system image.

classes.name: SettingsTabRouter
classes.description: An enum providing static methods to request and consume a pending tab selection, facilitating navigation between tabs programmatically.

methods.name: validTab(for:)
methods.description: Determines if the requested tab can be selected based on current state (e.g., disables debug tab if not enabled).

methods.name: refreshSnapshotPaths()
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and updates the snapshot paths configuration.

methods.name: refreshPerms()
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes the permission status via the permission monitor.

methods.name: updatePermissionMonitoring(for:)
methods.description: Turns on or off permission monitoring based on the selected tab.
